neighbours.label: Degree or manner nouns in a cause phrase (due to the amount of, because of the way, the budget the way it is): the cause lies in how much or how something is; the plain cause stays quiet
fire: The crew had to evacuate due to the amount of smoke.
Because of the way the printer handles errors, jobs restart.
Due to the extent of the flooding, the school closed.
With the economy the way it is, few people are hiring.
Given the amount of traffic, we left early.
Owing to the scale of the damage, the bridge was closed.
Because of how the law is written, nobody can appeal.
The way things are, we cannot afford a holiday.
quiet: The crew had to evacuate due to the smoke.
Because of an error, the print job restarted.
Due to flooding, the school closed for two days.
With the economy weak, few people are hiring.
Given the traffic, we left early.
Owing to the damage, the bridge was closed.
Because of the law, nobody can appeal.
We cannot afford a holiday this summer.
